title: Portuguese Stir Fry Vegetables
description: A flavorful and colorful stir fry made with a variety of vegetables and robust herbs, served as a vegetarian dinner option.
instructions: Heat the Vegetable Oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they start to caramelize.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook until they are tender.
Add the portobello mushrooms and cook until they are tender.
Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Sprinkle the Portuguese Robust Herbs on top and stir well.
Garnish with additional herbs if desired.
Serve with your favorite sides or as a standalone dish.
